create-secret-popover.nameExists: A secret with this name already exists

trust-preset-section.heading: Trust
trust-preset-section.presetHint: Choose how broadly this agent can read and act on Myrmidon work objects.
trust-preset-section.containmentActiveText: This agent can only read and mutate work inside its assigned review boundary. Raw output is quarantined from higher-trust agents until a trusted reviewer promotes it.
trust-preset-section.containmentMissingText: This agent is set to low-trust review, but no project, root issue, or issue scope is set in the core policy. Add a scope before this agent can run without denial.
trust-preset-section.ceOneBoundary: CE saves one containment boundary at a time. Saved policies include this organization id.
trust-preset-section.managedByEeText: This policy has {{summary}} and cannot be edited by the CE single-boundary editor.
trust-preset-section.wantMore: Want to set more than one containment boundary?
trust-preset-section.advancedNote: Advanced permissions remain editable through the EE permissions extension when installed.

invites-section.roleViewerDescription: Can view organization work and follow along.
invites-section.roleOperatorDescription: Recommended for people who need to help run work without managing access.
invites-section.roleAdminDescription: Recommended for operators who need to invite people, create agents, and approve joins.
invites-section.roleAdminGets: Can create agents, invite users, assign tasks, and approve join requests.
invites-section.roleOwnerDescription: Full organization access, including membership management.
invites-section.roleOwnerGets: Everything in Admin, plus managing members.
invites-section.inviteSelected: The invite URL is selected. Copy it manually from the field.
invites-section.copyManually: Copy the invite URL manually from the field below.
invites-section.inviteReadyCopied: Invite ready below and copied to clipboard.
invites-section.selectOrganization: Select an organization to manage invites.
invites-section.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage organization invites.
invites-section.intro: Invite people to request access to this organization. New invite links are copied to your clipboard when they are generated.
invites-section.inviteAPersonText: Generate a human invite link and choose the default access it should request.
invites-section.singleUseNote: Each invite link is single-use. Human invitees get the selected role immediately after sign-in; agent invites still create a join request for approval.
invites-section.historyNote: Invite history below keeps the audit trail.
invites-section.domainNote: This URL includes the current Myrmidon domain returned by the server.
invites-section.historyText: Review invite status, audience, inviter, and any linked join request.
invites-section.noInvites: No invites have been created for this organization yet.

environment-variables-editor.userSecretsNote: User secrets resolve from the user responsible for the run. Required bindings fail until that user sets their value under Secrets → My secrets.
